01 · ZERO OPS

Forget about infra

Monitoring, security patches, version upgrades: all handled. You ship the dApp; we keep the machinery invisible.

02 · SCALES TO ZERO

Pay for requests, not servers

Load-balanced instances appear when traffic spikes and disappear when it doesn't. Idle costs exactly $0.

03 · MULTI-REGION

99.9% SLA, measured publicly

Active-active redundancy across availability zones in every region. Our status page does the bragging.

FOUR APIS · ONE PLATFORM

Choose your own API

WebSockets, HTTP, REST or gRPC: pick the API that fits how you already build. Ogmios, Kupo, Blockfrost and UTxO RPC all run on the same multi-region backbone, so the choice is yours to change later.

$ get startedRead the docs
// blockfrost-compatible rest, mainnet
import { BlockFrostAPI } from "@blockfrost/blockfrost-js"
// the api key is the first label of the host
const api = new BlockFrostAPI({
"https://blockfrost1xxx.cardano-mainnet.blockfrost-m1.dmtr.host"
});
// every blockfrost endpoint works from here
const block = await api.blocksLatest();

Open source, top to bottom

NO VENDOR LOCK-IN · RUN IT YOURSELF ANY TIMEREAD THE DOCS →

Every API we host is open-source software with a public spec: the same binaries you can run on your own laptop. We operate them; we don't own them. If you ever want to leave, point your client at your own node and nothing in your code changes.

OPERATED BY EXPERTS

Multiple operators. Zero single points of failure.

Demeter is run jointly by TxPipe and Blink Labs, two independent engineering teams you already know from the Cardano ecosystem. Each runs a full, idempotent copy of the stack behind a health-checked load balancer: either provider can serve any request, so if one operator is out, your traffic never notices.
